verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one line on the Pipecat Cloud pricing page. It says Pipecat offers Krisp-powered noise elimination that removes background noise and voices causing false interruptions, which is a first-party capability aimed at this story. However, there is no documentation of how a developer enables or configures it, whether it exists in the open-source framework or only in Cloud, or any audio-filter processors. missing for 10: configuration/enablement docs, clarity on OSS vs Cloud availability, other filtering options, hands-on or independent corroboration of call quality improvement.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enable noise suppression or audio filtering so the agent stays coherent on noisy real-world calls

citations.quote: Eliminates background noise and voices that cause false interruptions, powered by Krisp.
